member.name: T:SextaFeira.CognitiveHUD.MainPage
member.summary:
The main HUD page — the only "screen" in the Sexta-Feira Cognitive OS.
Supports multi-layer navigation: - Tap core → expand radial menu (Level 1: modules) - Tap module → transition animation → Level 2 (sub-modules) - Tap sub-module → transition → Level 3 (actions) - Back button → reverse transition → previous level - Root button → instant return to Level 1

member.name: M:SextaFeira.CognitiveHUD.MauiProgram.BuildNavigationTree
member.summary: Builds the navigation tree used by NavigationController. Centralized so both DI registration and ViewModel can reference it.

member.name: T:SextaFeira.CognitiveHUD.Services.ApiClient
member.summary: HTTP client for communicating with the Sexta-Feira cognitive core backend (Python/FastAPI). All communication happens over local network (REST today, gRPC in future phases).

member.name: T:SextaFeira.CognitiveHUD.ViewModels.CoreHudViewModel
member.summary: Main ViewModel for the Sexta-Feira Cognitive HUD. Orchestrates the full layer-transition experience: collapse → particle burst → swap items → expand → update depth.

member.name: F:SextaFeira.CognitiveHUD.ViewModels.CoreHudViewModel.CoreRadiusDefault
member.summary: Default radius of the core circle, exposed for drawable calculations.

member.name: M:SextaFeira.CognitiveHUD.ViewModels.CoreHudViewModel.TransitionToCurrentLevel
member.summary: Rebuilds the menu items from the current navigation level and triggers a smooth TransitionTo animation.

member.name: T:SextaFeira.CognitiveHUD.Views.HudCanvasDrawable
member.summary:
Custom IDrawable that renders the entire HUD scene each frame.
Render order: 1. Background + subtle grid 2. Ambient orbital particles 3. Depth indicator rings (concentric circles showing current level) 4. Core circle (the "brain") 5. Radial menu items (when expanded) 6. Transition particle burst effects
